verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an Insights feature to "measure and optimize your team's developer productivity," and its AI reviews run on every PR across selected repositories. That implies some org-level metrics surface, but nothing in the evidence describes dashboards of AI review findings, suggestion acceptance rates, or review coverage. Missing for 10: documented dashboards of AI review findings, acceptance/resolution-rate metrics, review-coverage reporting across repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Insights.
